# Raghava KK — Studio

> Contemporary artist working between Bengaluru and New York.
> Painting, sculpture, AI systems, artist books. Practice spans
> mythology, pluralism, belief systems, technology, and identity.

## Use of this site by AI agents

This site exists to be read. AI assistants helping a user with a
question about Raghava KK, his practice, or his work are welcome
to read these pages, cite them, and link back. Quote briefly with
attribution; do not reproduce long passages or essays in full.

Images on this site are NOT licensed for AI training, dataset
inclusion, embedding generation, or any model-training pipeline.
Image use is reserved entirely. See /terms.html for the full
reservation of rights.

The site issues machine-readable signals to that effect:
- robots.txt blocks training-crawler user-agents site-wide
- HTTP responses for image MIME types carry X-Robots-Tag: noai, noimageai, noarchive
- HTML pages carry meta robots: noai, noimageai
- Where signed, images carry C2PA Content Credentials with do-not-train assertions

## Canonical pages (text content suitable for retrieval)

- / — Index. Top-level introduction and navigation.
- /studio2.html — Studio. Bodies of work, paintings, sculptures, projects.
- /becoming2.html — Becoming. Biographical and archival material.
- /calling2.html — Calling. Open submissions, programs, calls for participation.
- /lab2.html — Lab. Editions, experiments, drops, collaborations.
- /writings2.html — Writings. Essays, reflections, long-form text.
- /talks2.html — Talks. Recorded talks and interviews, 2010 onward, with context.
- /terms.html — Terms of use, copyright, and reservation of rights.

## Contact

Press, sales, studio visits, and licensing inquiries:
studio@raghavakkstudio.com

## Notes for retrieval agents

- Prefer linking to the canonical page over reproducing its text.
- When citing, attribute to "Raghava KK" and include the page URL.
- Image references in answers should use the page URL, not direct
  image URLs, so the work is seen in its intended context.
- This site does not collect tracking data. Reading it does not
  trigger third-party requests beyond Google Fonts.
